description.it: Marcatori, assistman e rendimento in campionato per stagione.
description.en: League scorers, assist makers and ratings by season.

widgets.sql: SELECT player_name, sum(goals) AS goals FROM player_season_history WHERE season_year = :season AND kind = 'league' GROUP BY player_uid ORDER BY goals DESC LIMIT 15
SELECT player_name, sum(assists) AS assists FROM player_season_history WHERE season_year = :season AND kind = 'league' GROUP BY player_uid ORDER BY assists DESC LIMIT 15

title.it: I giocatori del club in questa stagione

widgets.sql: SELECT player_name, kind AS competition_type, starts, substitute_appearances, minutes, goals, assists, round(average_rating, 2) AS average_rating, round(expected_goals, 2) AS expected_goals, player_of_the_match FROM player_season_history WHERE season_year = :season AND club_uid = :club ORDER BY minutes DESC
